heading: Part developer.
Part designer.
paragraphs: I care about the full shape of an idea: how it works, how it looks, and how it makes someone feel. My practice moves between interfaces, visual identities, and intelligent products.
Whether I’m refining a design system or prototyping with machine learning, I bring the same mix of clarity, craft, and experimentation to the work.

experience.intro: Three chapters tracing the journey from a first internship to web development and an AI-focused current role.
